text:
maya: quick sync  need to finalize Optimize toolkit scope for next sprint. three asks: auto-batching presets, per-route cache TTL + invalidate API, and a quant recommendation beta. can we commit?

zack: not all in one sprint. batching + basic cache UX doable. quant recs need eval infra, multi-sprint.

riya: customer-priority: AcmeHealth blocks on invalidation. propose sprint A = batching + invalidate API + TTL UI; sprint B = quant advisor + eval alerts.

oliver: must include a small eval-smoke during canary so we detect quality regressions from any quant changes. store per-route baseline.

sam: UX: TTL dropdown + "Invalidate" button is low effort. tooltip suggestions for TTLs. quant explainability deferred.

zack: dev estimates:
- batching presets: 3 dev-days
- cache invalidate API + audit log: 4 dev-days
- UI + docs: 2 dev-days
- quant advisor + eval infra: ~3w

maya: acceptance for sprint A?

riya: sprint A acceptance:
- batching presets (low/med/high) applied per-route
- POST /routes/{id}/invalidate exists and writes audit log entry
- TTL control visible in route settings
- canary with AcmeHealth for 72h, no p99 latency regression >10%

oliver: add monitoring gates: p95 latency <=1.25x baseline; error rate delta <0.3% over 5m windows; run 10 smoke prompts on canary.

zack: risks: shared prefix caching may cause stale reads. default eventual consistency; strong-consistency behind feature-flag. KV quota could block full KV-backed implementation. fallback: in-process TTL for pilot (less durable).

maya: rollout plan: behind FF -> internal -> AcmeHealth canary -> monitor 72h -> wider alpha. stop conditions: p50 latency regress >15% or error spike >0.5% sustained 10m.

riya: sprint B gating (quant advisor): mean token logprob delta >0.6 or n-gram overlap drop >3% triggers alerts. aim FP rate <5% post-tuning.

oliver: retention: keep eval fingerprints per-route+model for 90d. helps tuning alerts per-customer.

sam: docs: I'll draft FAQ on cache semantics and recommended presets; include fallback caveats for pilot.

maya: owners: batching=zack; cache API=zack; UI/docs=sam+riya; eval-spec=oliver. I'll update roadmap and schedule 30m kickoff tomorrow 10:00.

deploy-bot: CI build 1782468022 on feat/toolkit-lite passed (10m) :white_check_mark:

maya: thanks all  posting roadmap update after kickoff.
